question: Should this GitHub Copilot credential migration merge without live enterprise-policy coverage, given that it changes runtime credential validation and endpoint selection for existing enterprise profiles?
rationale: The supplied proof covers fine-grained PATs, public-host traffic, legacy device-login refresh states, and multiple transports, but explicitly excludes enterprise-policy behavior; accepting that residual compatibility risk requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add enterprise-path proof
options.body: Require focused enterprise-domain contract coverage or redacted live evidence for endpoint validation and existing-profile behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept the documented gap
options.body: Merge with the current public-host and legacy-profile evidence while explicitly accepting the remaining enterprise-policy uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Add enterprise-path proof
recommendation.body: Require focused enterprise-domain contract coverage or redacted live evidence for endpoint validation and existing-profile behavior before merge.
